findings.issue: Bloomberg's 'big options trade hedges S&P 500 plunge of up to 20% by April' (n2196, 14 February) was the closing line of the strictly earlier 2022-02-15 Coinbase lead's Smart Money View, a recycled caution; the paragraph also had no bullish professional voice, so the split was one-sided.
findings.resolution: Removed n2196 and added Forbes on the synergies of AMD's completed Xilinx deal (n0685, 14 February) as the bull case against NATO caution, Euronews scepticism and the Fed/liquidity warnings.

findings.issue: CNBC's 'new investors are seizing their greatest money-making asset' (n1851) does not evidence attention to chips or leverage, and the paragraph ended on a repeated reversal caution already made in When the Narrative Breaks.
findings.resolution: Cut n1851 and the repeated caution; the Seeking Alpha semiconductor-ETF ranking (n0681) and ETF Stream buy-the-dip piece (n1364) are tied to the 3x-wrapper decision.

findings.issue: 'A new Covid wave and fresh restrictions would also test the travel-resurgence story' was a generic, unevidenced hedge.
findings.resolution: Replaced with own-date evidence that the conflict is already reaching travel: KLM suspending Ukraine flights (Forbes, n1451, 12 February), alongside the existing WTI 92.07 USD/bbl level.

findings.issue: SOXL leverage repeats the 2022-02-04 TQQQ, 2022-02-09 Nvidia/SOXL and 2022-02-11 TQQQ items.
findings.resolution: Accepted as a material update: new catalyst (the 15 February partial pull-back claim, n1496, n1497, n1503, n1320) plus chip-specific deals (n0687, n0781, n0851), with all evidence published 14-15 February and no reuse of earlier leverage cautions or citations; only one leveraged-ETF item on the date.

scope_limits: Checked every cited ID against the 2022-02-16 frozen feed and every number against the 2022-02-16 card or a same-paragraph headline. The 15 February pull-back claim, Airbnb and Roblox results (after the 15 February US close, before the cutoff) are treated as known; retail sales, FOMC minutes and Nvidia/Cisco/DoorDash/Shopify results are not described (Nvidia appears only as 'next print' without a date). The PPI outcome is not used because the only headline is a Reuters LIVE MARKETS rolling page (n1326). Headlines only. Chronology compared with retail drafts and notes for 2022-02-01 to 2022-02-15 only.

recommended_exclusions.reason: Reuters 'LIVE MARKETS' rolling live blog; cannot certify a pre-cutoff PPI outcome.
